**Concept used:**

Ratio\:of\:X\:product={Total\:costover Manufacturing}

The Product has the least Ratio and also has the maximum manufacturing cost in comparison to its total cost of production.

**Calculation:**

=> Ratio\:of\:A\:product={900over 80}=11.25

=> Ratio\:of\:B\:product={500over 40}=12.5

=> Ratio\:of\:C\:product={1500over 150}=10

=> Ratio\:of\:D\:product={700over 80}=8.75

=> Ratio\:of\:E\:product={1000over 100}=10

Here, Ratio of D is least.

**Hence, product 'D' has the maximum manufacturing cost in comparison to its total cost of production.**
